newsitem.title: USA: Price REIT to offer 1.6 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Price REIT to offer 1.6 million shares.

text.p: The Price REIT Inc said it will offer 1.6 million shares of its common stock at $37.625 a share in a public offering underwritten by Merril Lynch, Dean Witter and Sutro & CO.
Underwriters will also have an option to purchase an additional 240,000 shares to cover any over-allotments.
Proceeds from the offering will be used to fund acquisition and development activities and to repay all the trust's outstanding debt under its line of credit.
Price REIT is a real estate investment trust.
